claims: Ángel Cabrera is an Argentine professional golfer.
Ángel Cabrera won the 2007 U.S. Open at Oakmont.
Ángel Cabrera won the 2009 Masters Tournament.
Ángel Cabrera served over two years in prison for domestic abuse charges from 2021 to 2023.
Ángel Cabrera won on the PGA Tour Champions in 2024.
Ángel Cabrera won on the PGA Tour Champions in 2025.
Ángel Cabrera was born in Córdoba, Argentina, in 1969.
Ángel Cabrera was raised by his grandmother.
Ángel Cabrera started as a caddie.
Ángel Cabrera is affectionately known as "El Pato".
"El Pato" is Spanish for "The Duck".
Ángel Cabrera's nickname "El Pato" is due to his waddling gait.
In July 2021, Ángel Cabrera was sentenced in Argentina to prison for assaulting, threatening, and harassing his ex-partner.
Ángel Cabrera was released on parole in August 2023.
After his release, Ángel Cabrera regained his visa for the U.S.
Ángel Cabrera returned to competition on the PGA Tour Champions in 2024.
Ángel Cabrera won the 2025 James Hardie Pro-Football Hall of Fame Invitational.
Ángel Cabrera won the 2025 Regions Tradition.
Ángel Cabrera was welcomed back to Augusta National as a past champion in 2024.
Dr. Ángel Cabrera is the president of the Georgia Institute of Technology.
